_comment: Texture bindings for foliage whose FBX carries none at all. Synty's Nature Biomes packs export their card-based trees and bushes with a single grey Lambert covering trunk and canopy alike, which texture_overrides.json cannot reach: it is keyed on the texture stem the FBX asks for, and there is no stem. Keyed by pack folder name, then by a filename glob, then by part, with the first matching glob winning, so put the specific ones first. 'canopy' is the leaf cards and is bound as a cutout; 'trunk' is the woody geometry they hang off, bound opaque; 'branches' is a separate twig mesh where a model has one. Values are path suffixes matched against the pack's shipped textures, exactly as in texture_overrides.json. The converter tells canopy from trunk by island size, since a Synty leaf card is one quad while a trunk is a single island of hundreds of triangles. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_verification: Canopy bindings were chosen by matching each pack's own LOD_Cards texture, which is a baked render of the finished tree, against every candidate leaf map, then confirmed by rendering. The method reproduces the two mappings that were independently known: leafPatch_01 for the birches and pohutukawaLeaf for the pohutukawas, the latter also an exact name match. Trunk bindings were confirmed by sampling each candidate at the trunk's own UV coordinates: on these models the trunk collapses to a single point of the pack atlas holding the bark colour it was authored with, the birches excepted, whose trunks span a whole dedicated bark map.
_uncertain: leafPatch_02 against leafPatch_04 for SM_Env_Tree_Meadow_* is the one mapping with no decisive evidence; the two maps are near identical in palette and neither is bound by any model that kept its binding. The bushes are chosen by pack convention rather than by a card, since Synty ships no LOD card for them. Change either here and reconvert with --force.
